steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each record batch is placed by its retention period and its consent status.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 batch is past its retention period

findings.title: Record past its retention period
findings.fix: Delete the record under the retention rule

findings.title: Record with no consent status where consent is needed
findings.fix: Record the consent status or delete the record

findings.title: Deletion done with no record of it

outcome.notChecked: Whether a record is needed for a legal reason.
